notes: Codex-app and ChatGPT-web routing cases. Positives cover body-derived titles, related-work reasoning, Codex lifecycle organization, and ChatGPT evidence worksheets with Project proposals. ChatGPT-web requests trigger a dedicated browser-backed adapter; a title-only Codex-sidebar row is not substituted for a ChatGPT body. Negatives protect other clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini), generic Git cleanup, browser-tab organization, and ordinary conversation summaries. The held_out split is the final untouched test set, matching the repository's active-skill eval convention.

train.query: Review and rename my recent Codex tasks from the full conversation bodies
Compare all Codex conversations for this repo and tell me which older work was superseded
Find the current owner of each unfinished Codex workstream and rename the related tasks
Create a periodic Codex automation that organizes changed tasks using our sparse emoji taxonomy
Mark the single most important unfinished Codex task red and concrete follow-up tasks yellow
Rename this Git branch and clean up stale files
Organize my ChatGPT web conversation history that appears in the Codex sidebar
Organize my ChatGPT web conversation history
Add emoji names to my Claude Code sessions
Read 30 recent chats on ChatGPT, group the related work, and give me evidence-backed emoji titles and existing Project moves for approval

validation.query: Use Codex task history to find duplicates and durable completed references for this repository
Put a verified completion check mark on the Codex titles whose outcomes were actually checked
Recommend which completed or superseded Codex tasks are archive candidates without archiving them yet
Read the recent relevant Codex chats for each project and distinguish done, continued elsewhere, and parked work
Summarize this one conversation without changing or organizing my Codex sidebar
Propose better names for my ChatGPT web chats after reading their bodies; use our emoji taxonomy but do not add completion status markers

held_out.query: Audit the Codex tasks for this project family; age alone must not mean obsolete
Make waiting, blocked, canonical, and superseded Codex tasks visually distinct in the sidebar
Build a browser extension that renames chat tabs
